types.name: Probability tables, expectation and variance
types.description: Gives a table of values and probabilities (or a pmf with an unknown k) and asks for k, E(X), E(X²) or Var(X).

types.name: Density and distribution functions
types.description: Gives a density f(x) or a cdf F(x) and asks for the constant, a probability over an interval, or the mean.

types.name: Binomial distribution
types.description: Fixed number of independent trials with constant success chance, or gives n, p, mean or variance of a binomial.

types.name: Poisson distribution
types.description: Mentions a Poisson variable or rare events at an average rate and asks for P(X = r), mean or variance.

types.name: Geometric, negative binomial and hypergeometric
types.description: Asks about the first or r-th success, or drawing without replacement from a lot (geometric, negative binomial, hypergeometric).

types.name: Uniform and exponential distributions
types.description: Mentions a uniform interval or an exponential waiting time or life and asks for a mean, variance or probability.

types.name: Normal distribution
types.description: Mentions a normal distribution, z-scores or areas under the bell curve.
